Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 4, 2026) - Wesdome Gold Mines Ltd.
(OTCQX: WDOFF) ("
Wesdome
" or the "
Company

") is pleased to announce that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.0306 per common share. The dividend is payable on December 29, 2026, to shareholders of record as at the close of business on the record date of December 15, 2026. The dividend is designated as an "eligible dividend" for Canadian income tax purposes. Including the upcoming dividend, Wesdome will have returned approximately $186 million to shareholders thus far in 2026 through dividends and share buybacks.
Dividend Reinvestment Plan
The Company has a dividend reinvestment plan ("
DRIP

") in place, which provides eligible shareholders with the opportunity to automatically reinvest all or a portion of the cash dividends declared on their common shares into additional common shares of the Company, without incurring any transaction costs. For shareholders who elect to participate in the DRIP, common shares will be purchased by the Company's agent, Computershare Trust Company of Canada (the "
Agent
"), on the Canadian open market including through the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Participation in the DRIP is optional. For further information on the plan, including the forms needed to enroll, please log in to the Agent's website at

. In order to be eligible to participate in the December 29, 2026 dividend, enrollment must be completed no later than 5:00 p.m. ET on the fifth business day prior to the December 15, 2026 dividend record date.
About Wesdome

Wesdome is a Canadian-focused gold producer with two high-grade underground assets - the Eagle River mine in Ontario and the Kiena mine in Quebec. The Company's primary goal is to responsibly leverage its operating platform and high-quality brownfield and greenfield exploration pipeline to build a value-driven mid-tier Canadian gold producer.
